hypotheses.justification: B := Aᵐᵒᵖ is a finite-dimensional k-algebra, because A is. For such algebras, being self-injective on one side implies it on the other side (they are quasi-Frobenius; Lam, Lectures on Modules and Rings, Thm 15.1, a reference the file itself cites). So hl follows from hr. Short argument: let e_1,…,e_n be a complete set of primitive orthogonal idempotents, one per isomorphism class. If B_B is injective (hr), each indecomposable projective e_iB is an indecomposable injective. The modules e_iB are pairwise non-isomorphic, and there are exactly n isomorphism classes of indecomposable injective right modules, namely D(Be_j) with D = Hom_k(-, k). So every indecomposable injective is projective. Then D(_B B), a finite direct sum of indecomposable injectives, is projective as a right module, and _B B ≅ D(D(_B B)) is injective as a left module because the k-duality D swaps projectives and injectives on finite-dimensional modules. That is hl (Mathlib's `Module.Injective` is the standard notion, and B lives in the same universe as the modules involved). In the proof, hl is only used to build `FGModuleCat.abelian_isFrobenius`; it can be derived from hr first. This needs this QF-symmetry lemma, which does not seem to be in Mathlib or the library, but the statement is still true and provable. hl and hr can each be deleted, but not both: without either one, finitely generated modules over a non-self-injective algebra need not be Gorenstein-projective.

Symmetric to hl. B := Aᵐᵒᵖ is finite-dimensional over k, and B^op ≅ A is too, so the same quasi-Frobenius argument applied to B^op shows that right self-injectivity of B (hl) implies left self-injectivity (hr): each indecomposable projective left module Be_i is an indecomposable injective, and counting isomorphism classes shows that all indecomposable injectives are projective. Then D(B_B) is projective, so _B B ≅ D(D(B_B)) is injective. Once hr is derived from hl, the existing proof (Frobenius structure plus `isTotallyAcyclic_of_acyclic_of_moduleInjective_self hr`) goes through unchanged. Only one of hr and hl can be deleted, not both.
